facts.text: Serve the drink for Jobu when Cerrano steps up to bat.
facts.why: Cerrano makes his Jobu offerings of rum and cigars in the locker room, not at the plate. The data cue has the same wording.
facts.fix: Serve the drink for Jobu when Cerrano makes his offering in the locker room.

facts.text: Lou Brown's order, tyre salesman's hours.
facts.why: No source opened shows Lou Brown ordering a boilermaker, and the plot opened does not mention him selling tyres.
